Descriptor.description: Plugin/skillset metadata — defines the identity, display info, and authentication for your plugin.
Descriptor.markdownDescription:
**Plugin/Skillset Metadata**

Defines identity, display info, and authentication.

- `Name` — Internal unique identifier (no spaces/special chars)
- `DisplayName` — Shown in the Security Copilot UI
- `Description` — Explains what the plugin does
- `SupportedAuthTypes` — Auth methods your API supports

defaultSnippets.label: Descriptor (basic)
defaultSnippets.description: Basic descriptor with name and description

Name.description: Internal name of the skill set. Must be unique. No / \ ? # @ or whitespace.
Name.markdownDescription:
**Internal Name** — Unique identifier for the skill set.

⚠️ No `/`, `\`, `?`, `#`, `@`, or whitespace allowed.

Example: `MyApiPlugin`, `ThreatIntelLookup`

DisplayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the Security Copilot UI.
DisplayName.markdownDescription:
**Display Name** — Human-readable name shown in the Security Copilot UI.

Example: `My Threat Intel Plugin`

Description.description: Human-readable description of the skill set.
Description.markdownDescription:
**Description** — Explains what this plugin does. This helps Security Copilot decide when to invoke your skills.

Tip: Be specific about capabilities.

CatalogScope.description: Scope of the plugin catalog. UserWorkspace = only you, Tenant = entire organization.
CatalogScope.markdownDescription:
**Catalog Scope** — Who can see this plugin.

- `UserWorkspace` — Only the user who uploaded it
- `Tenant` — Everyone in the organization

Icon.description: Icon URL or data URI for the plugin.

SupportedAuthTypes.markdownDescription:
**Supported Auth Types** — Authentication methods your API supports.

- `None` — No auth required
- `AAD` — Microsoft Entra ID (service-to-service)
- `AADDelegated` — Microsoft Entra ID (delegated/user context)
- `ApiKey` — API key in header or query
- `Basic` — Basic username/password
- `OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow` — OAuth 2.0 auth code
- `OAuthClientCredentialsFlow` — OAuth 2.0 client credentials
- `ServiceHttp` — Custom HTTP auth

Authorization.markdownDescription: **Authorization** — Configure how Security Copilot authenticates to your API.

Type.markdownDescription:
**Auth Type** — The authentication method.

- `AAD` — Service-to-service Microsoft Entra auth
- `AADDelegated` — Delegated user-context Entra auth
- `ApiKey` — API key (header or query param)
- `Basic` — Username/password
- `OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow` — OAuth 2.0 auth code flow
- `OAuthClientCredentialsFlow` — OAuth 2.0 client credentials
- `ServiceHttp` — Custom HTTP header auth

EntraScopes.description: Comma-separated list of Microsoft Entra scopes (for AAD/AADDelegated).
EntraScopes.markdownDescription:
**Entra Scopes** — Microsoft Entra ID permission scopes.

Example: `https://graph.microsoft.com/.default`

Key.description: Header or query parameter name for API key auth.
Key.markdownDescription:
**Key Name** — The HTTP header or query parameter name.

Examples: `X-Api-Key`, `Authorization`, `api-key`

Location.description: Where to send the API key.
Location.markdownDescription:
**Key Location** — Where to include the API key.

- `Header` — In an HTTP header
- `QueryParams` — As a URL query parameter

AuthScheme.markdownDescription:
**Auth Scheme** — Prefix for the auth value.

- Empty string `""` — No prefix
- `Bearer` — Bearer token
- `Basic` — Basic auth

Settings.description: Configurable settings for the plugin. These appear in the Security Copilot UI when configuring the plugin.
Settings.markdownDescription:
**Plugin Settings** — User-configurable parameters shown in Security Copilot UI.

Use settings for values like API endpoints, tenant IDs, or thresholds that vary per deployment.

Name.description: Setting name. Reference in templates as <<SettingName>>.

Label.description: Display label for the setting in the UI.

Description.description: Setting description shown to the user.

HintText.description: Placeholder text in the input field.

AgentDefinitions.description: Agent configuration definitions. Agents orchestrate skills to automate security workflows.
AgentDefinitions.markdownDescription:
**Agent Definitions** — Define autonomous or interactive agents.

Agents combine multiple skills and can be triggered on a schedule, by events, or interactively by users.

Name.description: Agent name. No whitespace or periods.
Name.markdownDescription:
**Agent Name** — Internal identifier. No whitespace or periods.

This must match a `RequiredSkillsets` entry in the same manifest.

DisplayName.description: User-friendly name shown in the Security Copilot UI.

Description.description: Summary of the agent's purpose. Used by Security Copilot for routing.

Publisher.description: Name of the agent's publisher or organization.

Product.description: Source product associated with the agent.

RequiredSkillsets.description: Skillsets this agent needs. Must reference Descriptor.Name values.
RequiredSkillsets.markdownDescription:
**Required Skillsets** — List of skillset names this agent depends on.

Must match the `Descriptor.Name` of skill manifests (can be the same file or separate files).

AgentSingleInstanceConstraint.markdownDescription:
**Instance Constraint** — Where the agent can be deployed.

- `None` — No constraint
- `Workspace` — One instance per workspace
- `Tenant` — One instance per tenant

PreviewState.markdownDescription:
**Preview State**

- `Private` — Only visible to the creator
- `Public` — Visible to all users in scope

Triggers.description: Defines how and when the agent is triggered.
Triggers.markdownDescription:
**Triggers** — Define how the agent is invoked.

- **Scheduled**: Set `DefaultPeriodSeconds` with `FetchSkill` + `ProcessSkill`
- **Interactive**: Set `DefaultPollPeriodSeconds: 0` with `PromptSkill`

DefaultPeriodSeconds.description: Interval in seconds for scheduled execution. 0 = disabled.
DefaultPeriodSeconds.markdownDescription:
**Schedule Interval** — How often the agent runs (in seconds).

- `3600` = every hour
- `86400` = daily
- `0` = disabled

DefaultPollPeriodSeconds.description: Poll interval in seconds. Set to 0 for interactive agents.
DefaultPollPeriodSeconds.markdownDescription: **Poll Period** — For interactive agents, set to `0`.

FetchSkill.description: Skill to fetch data. Format: SkillsetName.SkillName
FetchSkill.markdownDescription:
**Fetch Skill** — Retrieves data for the agent.

Format: `SkillsetName.SkillName`

ProcessSkill.description: Skill to process data. Format: SkillsetName.SkillName
ProcessSkill.markdownDescription:
**Process Skill** — Processes/analyzes data from the fetch step.

Format: `SkillsetName.SkillName`

PromptSkill.description: Skill for interactive prompts. Format: SkillsetName.SkillName
PromptSkill.markdownDescription:
**Prompt Skill** — The skill that handles user prompts in interactive agents.

Format: `SkillsetName.SkillName`

SkillGroups.markdownDescription:
**Skill Groups** — Groups of skills organized by format type.

Each group has a `Format` (API, KQL, GPT, AGENT, LogicApp, MCP) and a list of `Skills`.

Format.markdownDescription:
**Format** — The type of skills in this group.

- `API` — REST API with OpenAPI spec
- `KQL` — Kusto Query Language (Defender/Sentinel/Kusto)
- `GPT` — LLM prompt template
- `AGENT` / `Agent` — Orchestrator agent skill
- `LogicApp` — Azure Logic App trigger
- `MCP` — Model Context Protocol server

Settings.markdownDescription:
**Group Settings** — Configuration that applies to all skills in this group.

For API format: set `OpenApiSpecUrl` and `EndpointUrl` here.

OpenApiSpecUrl.description: URL to the public OpenAPI specification.
OpenApiSpecUrl.markdownDescription: **OpenAPI Spec URL** — Public URL to your OpenAPI 3.0 YAML/JSON spec.

EndpointUrl.markdownDescription: **Endpoint URL** — Base URL for API calls. Can use `<<SettingName>>` for configurable URLs.

EndpointUrlSettingName.description: Setting name for configurable endpoint URL.

EnableSkillContextApi.description: Enable SkillContext API access for API tools.
EnableSkillContextApi.markdownDescription: **Enable SkillContext API** — When `true`, your API receives Security Copilot session context.

PackageUrl.description: Public URL for zip file with KQL template.
PackageUrl.markdownDescription: **Package URL** — Public URL to a zip file containing KQL template files.

Skills.description: List of skills (tools) in this group.
Skills.markdownDescription:
**Skills** — Individual tools/capabilities in this group.

Each skill has a name, description, inputs, and format-specific settings.

Name.description: Internal name. No whitespace or periods.
Name.markdownDescription:
**Skill Name** — Internal identifier. No whitespace or periods.

Referenced as `SkillsetName.SkillName` in triggers and ChildSkills.

Description.description: Skill description. Used by Security Copilot to determine when to invoke this skill.
Description.markdownDescription:
**Description** — Explains what this skill does.

⚠️ This is critical — Security Copilot uses this to decide when to invoke the skill. Be specific.

Interfaces.markdownDescription:
**Interfaces** — Special interfaces this skill implements.

- `Agent` — Autonomous agent skill
- `InteractiveAgent` — Interactive (user-prompted) agent skill

Inputs.markdownDescription:
**Inputs** — Parameters the skill accepts.

Reference in templates as `{{ParameterName}}`.

Name.description: Parameter name. Reference in templates as {{Name}}.
Name.markdownDescription: **Parameter Name** — Reference in KQL/GPT templates as `{{Name}}`.

Description.description: Parameter description. Helps Security Copilot extract the right value from user prompts.
Description.markdownDescription:
**Description** — Explains what value this parameter expects.

Security Copilot uses this to extract the correct value from the user's natural language prompt.

DefaultValue.description: Default value when not provided by the user.

ModelName.markdownDescription: **Model Name** — The LLM model for GPT skills. Must be `gpt-4.1`.

Model.markdownDescription: **Model** — The LLM model for Agent skills. Must be `gpt-4.1`.

Template.description: GPT prompt template or KQL query. Use {{paramName}} for input references. Max 80,000 chars.
Template.markdownDescription:
**Template** — The prompt or query template.

- For **KQL**: Write your Kusto query here
- For **GPT**: Write your prompt here

Use `{{paramName}}` to reference input parameters.
Use `<<settingName>>` to reference plugin settings.

TemplateUrl.description: Public URL to download KQL template.

TemplateFile.description: Relative path to KQL template within PackageUrl zip.

Instructions.description: Agent instructions defining behavior and mission.
Instructions.markdownDescription:
**Instructions** — System prompt for the agent.

Define the agent's purpose, behavior rules, and how it should use its child skills.

Target.markdownDescription:
**Target** — Where to execute the KQL query.

- `Defender` — Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting
- `Sentinel` — Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics
- `Kusto` — Azure Data Explorer (Kusto)

TenantId.description: AAD Tenant ID (required for Sentinel target).
TenantId.markdownDescription:
**Tenant ID** — Your Microsoft Entra ID tenant GUID.

Required when Target is `Sentinel`.

SubscriptionId.markdownDescription:
**Subscription ID** — Azure subscription GUID.

Required for `Sentinel` and `LogicApp` targets.

WorkspaceName.markdownDescription:
**Workspace Name** — The Log Analytics workspace name.

Required when Target is `Sentinel`.

WorkflowName.markdownDescription: **Workflow Name** — The name of the Logic App workflow to trigger.

TriggerName.markdownDescription:
**Trigger Name** — The trigger within the Logic App.

Usually `manual` for HTTP-triggered Logic Apps.

Cluster.markdownDescription:
**Cluster** — Azure Data Explorer cluster URL.

Example: `https://mycluster.westus.kusto.windows.net`

OpenApiSpecUrl.description: URL to OpenAPI spec (at skill level).

ChildSkills.description: Skills the agent can invoke. Format: SkillsetName.SkillName
ChildSkills.markdownDescription:
**Child Skills** — List of skills this agent can call.

Format: `SkillsetName.SkillName`

The agent will choose which child skills to invoke based on its instructions.

SuggestedPrompts.markdownDescription:
**Suggested Prompts** — Pre-defined prompts shown to users in the Security Copilot UI.

Helps users discover what the agent can do.

Prompt.description: The actual prompt text sent to the agent.

Personas.description: Persona types the prompt is for.

IsStarterAgent.description: Whether this is a starter prompt shown by default.
